title: When Is Tooth Extraction Necessary: Guide for Patients
seoTitle: When Is Tooth Extraction Necessary? Key Reasons
seoDescription: Learn when a tooth should be removed, when it can be saved, and what to ask before agreeing to an extraction. Talk with our Valencia oral surgery team.
excerpt: The clinical reasons a tooth may need to come out, when saving it is the better path, and the questions to ask before you agree to an extraction.
keyTakeaways: Common reasons: decay or infection a root canal cannot resolve, severe gum disease, root fractures and impacted wisdom teeth.
Extractions are sometimes planned for orthodontics or prosthetics; ask for a clear rationale and imaging first.
Saving a tooth is usually preferred when root canal, periodontal treatment or a crown can restore predictable function.
Before recommending removal, your dentist should review medical history, exam findings, imaging and the alternatives.
Typical simple-extraction recovery: pain and swelling for 48 to 72 hours and soft tissue healing within one to two weeks.
